description: Election Commission - Declare that A. Shanthi as a member of the Puthukkudiyiruppu Pradishiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Puthukkudiyiruppu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy created by resignation, which falls under election-related matters rather than general government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
